scientific_integrity: All claimed infinite-dimensional conclusions are supported by the written analytic proof; packaged exact-rational checks are finite consistency tests, and bibliographic priority remains subject to external confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Exact covering requires \(0<\lambda<1/3\); the strict positive critical logarithmic Hausdorff measure requires a bounded-type irrational rotation. No exact numerical measure or unbounded-type classification is proved.
title: Exact logarithmic covering and positive critical gauge for irrational contracted rotations
